title: 第二十五章 惊天翻转第二十六章 乾元决
content_zh:
赵大鹏眼神一厉，继续道：“叶枫，是本庄主结拜大哥叶天嫡子，当年叶大哥对我，对本庄庄客族人无不关心爱护，现在他不知下落，你们怎么就能做出欺凌侮辱他后人子嗣的事？”
“叶天大哥虽然不在了，他的儿子，就是我赵大鹏的儿子，今天本庄主在此重申，如果再有人胆敢冒犯冲撞叶枫，那就是冲撞本人，赵天乐、赵火等咎由自取，死有余辜，哪怕叶枫不出手，本庄主也绝不会留他们的狗命。”
周围人看向叶枫的眼神，瞬间变得恭顺起来。
他们依稀记得，当年庄主确实说过类似的话，只不过赵大鹏为了冲击先天境，近些年忙于闭关，这才让大家都把之前的告诫丢到了九霄云外。
“都听清楚没有？”
赵大鹏高声冷喝道。
“听，听清楚了……”
“仑儿，你听清楚没有？从今往后，叶枫就是你弟弟，花菱就是你妹妹，必须像一家人一样关心爱护。
现在你道个歉，之前的恩怨，一笔勾销。”
“什么？我还要道歉？”
赵仑惊讶的眼珠子瞪得滚圆，父亲居然说出这样的话，居然让自己向叶枫道歉？
一瞬之间，他心中那股怨恨再也抑制不住，刹那间爆发了出来。
“我赵仑五条武脉，天资绝伦，日后注定要成为宗门子弟，扬威整个巴立城，这叶枫，一个一条武脉的废物，凭什么和我平起平坐，成为我的兄弟？”
“混账，叶枫是你叶伯伯唯一骨血，休的胡言乱语。”
赵大鹏挑眉喝道。
“我赵仑，羞于与他为伍。”
啪……
一道清脆声音响起，在上百赵姓族人目瞪口呆注视之下，赵大鹏竟然打了一向当做宝贝般呵护的赵仑一个耳光。
这耳光沉重有力，立刻，就让赵仑脸庞青肿，留下了五条清晰的手印。
周围人也像同时挨了一记沉重耳光般，心神猛地一震。

“你，你竟然为了他打我？从小到大，你都没打过我……”
赵仑大吼一声，撞开人群疯狂奔了出去。
“哎，孽障……”
“叶枫，都怪赵叔平时管教不严，才让这孽子肆无忌惮。”
望着面前的叶枫，赵大鹏苦笑中露出一丝无奈。
“这些年赵叔忙于修炼，疏忽了你，也苦了你们兄妹，我，我对不起叶大哥。”
他声音中有着浓浓的自责，一对虎目也是变得通红。
“赵庄主……”
叶枫欲言又止。
“你还叫我赵庄主？好了，从前的事就别提了，从今天起，你和花菱搬到大院中去住，听说你已经觉醒了武脉？只有一条？没有关系，赵叔传你功法、武技，一定会让你扬眉吐气，不至于辱没了当年叶大哥的风采。”
“走吧……随我一道回去。”
赵大鹏大手一挥，恢复了之前的豪迈。
花菱轻轻拉了拉叶枫衣袖。
说实在，对这位平时根本见不到人影的赵庄主，花菱存有强烈的不安全感。
content_en:
Zhao Dapeng's eyes were sharp and he continued: "Ye Feng is the legitimate son of Ye Tian, the sworn brother of the owner of this village. Back then, Brother Ye showed no care and love for me and the Hakka people of this village. Now his whereabouts are unknown. How can you bully and insult his descendants?"
"Although Brother Ye Tian is gone, his son is my son, Zhao Dapeng. Today, the owner of this village reiterates that if anyone dares to offend Ye Feng again, it will be Chong himself. Zhao Tianle, Zhao Huo and others are responsible for their own faults and deserve to die. Even if Ye Feng does not take action, our owner will never spare their lives."
The people around him looked at Ye Feng and instantly became respectful.
They vaguely remembered that the owner of the village did say similar words back then, but Zhao Dapeng had been busy in retreat in recent years in order to attack the Xiantian realm, which made everyone throw away the previous warning.
"Did you hear everything clearly?"
Zhao Dapeng shouted coldly.
"Listen, hear me clearly..."
"Lun'er, did you hear clearly? From now on, Ye Feng is your brother and Hua Ling is your sister. They must be cared for and loved like a family.
Now you apologize and the previous grudges can be wiped out. "
"What? Do I still want to apologize?"
Zhao Lun's eyes widened in surprise. His father actually said such words and asked himself to apologize to Ye Feng?
In an instant, the resentment in his heart could no longer be suppressed and burst out in an instant.
"I, Zhao Lun, have five martial arts veins and are extremely talented. I am destined to become a disciple of the sect in the future and be famous throughout the entire city of Bali. How can this Ye Feng, a useless person with one martial arts vein, be on an equal footing with me and become my brother?"
"Asshole, Ye Feng is the only flesh and blood of your Uncle Ye. Hugh's nonsense."
Zhao Dapeng raised his eyebrows and shouted.
"I, Zhao Lun, am ashamed to be with him."
Snap...
A clear voice sounded, and under the stunned gazes of hundreds of people surnamed Zhao, Zhao Dapeng actually slapped Zhao Lun, who had always been caring for him like a treasure.
The slap was heavy and powerful, and immediately left Zhao Lun's face bruised and swollen, leaving five clear fingerprints.
The people around him were shaken as if they had received a heavy slap in the face at the same time.
"You, you actually hit me because of him? You have never hit me since you were a child..."
Zhao Lun roared, pushed through the crowd and ran out wildly.
"Hey, evil..."
"Ye Feng, it's all because of Uncle Zhao's lax discipline that allowed this evil boy to act unscrupulously."
Looking at Ye Feng in front of him, Zhao Dapeng showed a trace of helplessness in his wry smile.
"Uncle Zhao has been busy cultivating these years and has neglected you, which has also made you brothers and sisters suffer. I, I am sorry for Brother Ye."
There was deep self-blame in his voice, and his eyes turned red.
"Master Zhao..."
Ye Feng hesitated to speak.
"You still call me Zhuangzhu Zhao? Well, let's forget about the past. From today on, you and Hua Ling will move to the compound. I heard that you have awakened the martial arts vein? Only one? It doesn't matter. Uncle Zhao will teach you martial arts and martial arts, which will definitely make you feel proud and proud, and will not disgrace Brother Ye's demeanor back then."
"Let's go...come back with me."
Zhao Dapeng waved his hand and regained his previous boldness.
Hua Ling gently pulled Ye Feng's sleeve.
To be honest, Hua Ling had a strong sense of insecurity towards the owner of the village, Zhao, who was never seen at all.
